<template>
  <el-dialog v-model="dialogVisible" title="添加测试计划" width="600px" :close-on-click-modal="false">
    <el-form :model="form" :rules="dynamicRules" ref="formRef" label-width="100px" validate-on-rule-change="false">
      <el-form-item label="计划名称" prop="name">
        <el-input v-model="form.name" />
      </el-form-item>

      <el-form-item label="测试类型" prop="type">
        <el-select v-model="form.type" placeholder="请选择测试类型">
          <el-option label="TCP" value="TCP" />
          <el-option label="UDP" value="UDP" />
          <el-option label="HTTP" value="HTTP" />
          <el-option label="PING" value="PING" />
        </el-select>
      </el-form-item>

      <!-- TCP & UDP & PING -->
      <el-form-item label="容器1" prop="container1" v-if="showField('container1')">
        <el-input v-model="form.container1" />
      </el-form-item>

      <!-- TCP & UDP -->
      <el-form-item label="容器2" prop="container2" v-if="showField('container2')">
        <el-input v-model="form.container2" />
      </el-form-item>

      <!-- TCP & UDP & HTTP & PING -->
      <el-form-item label="容器2 IP" prop="container2Ip" v-if="showField('container2Ip')">
        <el-input v-model="form.container2Ip" />
      </el-form-item>

      <!-- TCP & UDP -->
      <el-form-item label="大小" prop="size" v-if="showField('size')">
        <el-input-number v-model="form.size" :min="0" />
      </el-form-item>

      <!-- TCP -->
      <el-form-item label="时间" prop="time" v-if="showField('time')">
        <el-input v-model="form.time" />
      </el-form-item>

      <!-- UDP -->
      <el-form-item label="速度" prop="velocity" v-if="showField('velocity')">
        <el-input v-model="form.velocity" />
      </el-form-item>

      <!-- PING -->
      <el-form-item label="数量" prop="num" v-if="showField('num')">
        <el-input-number v-model="form.num" :min="1" />
      </el-form-item>
    </el-form>

    <template #footer>
      <el-button type="primary" @click="submitForm">提交</el-button>
      <el-button @click="dialogVisible = false">取消</el-button>
    </template>
  </el-dialog>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, defineExpose } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'

const dialogVisible = ref(false)
const formRef = ref(null)

const form = ref({
  id: null,
  name: '',
  type: '',
  size: null,
  time: '',
  num: null,
  velocity: '',
  container1: '',
  container2: '',
  container2Ip: '',
})

// 不同类型对应的需要填写字段
const fieldMap = {
  TCP: ['container1', 'container2', 'container2Ip', 'size', 'time'],
  UDP: ['container1', 'container2', 'container2Ip', 'size', 'velocity'],
  HTTP: ['container1', 'container2Ip'],
  PING: ['container1', 'container2Ip', 'num', 'size'],
}

// 根据选中类型动态决定显示哪些字段
const showField = (field) => {
  const type = form.value.type
  return fieldMap[type]?.includes(field)
}

// 动态生成表单校验规则
const dynamicRules = computed(() => {
  const requiredRule = (label) => [{ required: true, message: `请输入${label}`, trigger: 'blur' }]
  const type = form.value.type
  const rules = {
    name: requiredRule('名称'),
    type: requiredRule('类型'),
  }
  const fields = fieldMap[type] || []
  if (fields.includes('container1')) rules.container1 = requiredRule('容器1')
  if (fields.includes('container2')) rules.container2 = requiredRule('容器2')
  if (fields.includes('container2Ip')) rules.container2Ip = requiredRule('容器2 IP')
  if (fields.includes('size')) rules.size = requiredRule('大小')
  if (fields.includes('time')) rules.time = requiredRule('时间')
  if (fields.includes('velocity')) rules.velocity = requiredRule('速度')
  if (fields.includes('num')) rules.num = requiredRule('数量')
  return rules
})

const openDialog = () => {
  resetForm()
  dialogVisible.value = true
}

defineExpose({ openDialog })

const submitForm = () => {
  formRef.value.validate(async (valid) => {
    if (valid) {
      try {
        const response = await axios.post('http://localhost:8081/plan/add', form.value)
        if (response.data === '添加成功') {
          ElMessage.success('添加成功')
          dialogVisible.value = false
        } else {
          ElMessage.warning(response.data)
        }
      } catch (error) {
        ElMessage.error('添加失败')
        console.error(error)
      }
    }
  })
}

const resetForm = () => {
  form.value = {
    id: null,
    name: '',
    type: '',
    size: null,
    time: '',
    num: null,
    velocity: '',
    container1: '',
    container2: '',
    container2Ip: '',
  }
}
</script>
